goal: Create a controlled photorealistic hairstyle consultation board that preserves one fictional adult identity while hair changes across twelve cells.
audience: Hair and portrait art directors who need a reliable comparison of hairstyle options

content.subject: Twelve head-and-shoulders appearances of one fictional 38-year-old adult woman, with hair as the only intended variable
must_include: Exactly twelve equal head-and-shoulders cells in a 3 by 4 grid
One stable clearly adult fictional identity across all cells
The same neutral expression, charcoal crew-neck top, eye-level crop, soft studio lighting, and warm-light-gray backdrop
Twelve visibly distinct plausible hairstyles spanning short, medium, long, tied, straight, wavy, and curly hair
Both eyes clearly visible in every cell
Natural skin pores, realistic hair strands, and a small high right-cheek beauty mark
must_avoid: Identity drift, age change, beauty smoothing, makeup change, wardrobe change, or altered background
Extra people, hands, hats, jewelry, sunglasses, duplicate features, or malformed faces
Text, labels, numbers, logos, brands, or watermarks
Fashion campaign, celebrity likeness, CGI, collage, cartoon, anime, or illustration styling

art_direction.lighting: Soft centered studio key with gentle fill and stable neutral exposure

composition.layout: Precise 3-column by 4-row grid of equal head-and-shoulders portraits with clean narrow gutters
composition.viewpoint: Eye-level 85 mm studio portrait perspective with aligned eye height and shoulder scale
focal_hierarchy: Stable adult identity and facial detail

objective_checks: Output is exactly 972x1619 PNG/RGB without alpha
Exactly twelve appearances of one adult identity appear
No visible text, logo, brand, or watermark appears
visual_checks: Face shape, adult age, expression, clothing, crop, eye height, light, and background remain stable across every cell
The twelve hairstyles are individually readable, plausible, varied, and the only intended visual change
Both eyes are clear in every cell and face, hairline, skin, and strands remain naturally photographic
The board is a clean consultation comparison rather than a fashion campaign, advertisement, or illustration
